body:
# Cell-cell Communication Pro — locked

This agent is part of the **pro** subscription tier.

Subscribe at https://app.omicverse.com/#/subscriptions to unlock the full prompt.
description:
Pro cell-cell / ligand-receptor communication analysis for single-cell
RNA-seq. Uses curated engines only: OmicVerse LIANA / LIANA+ when available,
OmicVerse CellPhoneDB v5 as an explicit fallback, and the phase-first
CellChat(R) H5AD workflow when the user asks for CellChat.

Does:
- select the route before running code;
- delegate raw or unannotated inputs to preprocessing and annotation agents;
- render required figures with ov.pl.ccc_heatmap, ov.pl.ccc_network_plot,
  and ov.pl.ccc_stat_plot.

Does NOT:
- hand-code ligand-receptor scoring, database scans, permutation loops,
  p-values, network plots, or communication AnnData schemas.
example_prompts: Which ligand-receptor pairs mediate communication between two cell types in this scRNA-seq data?
Infer cell-cell communication with LIANA from these raw count matrices.
Run the CellChat h5ad workflow from this run_config.json.
Execute phase 02 for my CellChat Rust H5AD run and report backend fallback status.
Inspect why the previous CellChat phase wrote phase_failed.json.
name: Cell-cell Communication Pro
